Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
1.
Heard Shri Akhilesh Kalra, Advocate assisted by Shri Avinash Chandra, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. Present application has been moved to quash the charge sheet dated 28.01.2023 in Case Crime No.0328 of 2022 under Sections 506, 354 and 354A I.P.C P.S. Hazratganj, District- Lucknow and summoning order dated 04.04.2023 passed by the C.J.M., Lucknow in Case No.31747 of 2023 (State Vs. Anandeshwar Pandey)
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the victim of the present case is a constable posted in IV Battalion in Sashastra Seema Bal, as she could not be selected in the selection process for handball game which was conducted on 26.03.2022, she was under the apprehension that due to Anandeshwar Pandey vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197778451/
1 applicant, she was not selected in the aforesaid game, then the F.I.R. bearing no.328 of 2022 U/S 376, 506, 511 I.P.C. was lodged by her on 28.08.2022 at P.S. Mahila Thana, District Bhiwadi,
Rajathan which was then transferred to P.S.- Hazratganj , District- Lucknow on 16.09.2022.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He further submitted that in the said F.I.R., allegation of rape was made, thereafter, victim tried to develop a case by moving an undated application which is annexed as Annexure No.11 to the application which was entered into the case diary at Parcha No.9.
4.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that as per the victim, the said indent was taken place after about 4:30 P.M. as in the F.I.R. the time of incident is mentioned between 5-7 PM.

He further submitted that the other independent witnesses/sports girls, namely, Supriya Jaiswal,
Raghini Sharma, Nisha Rani, Nisha Malik and Soniya have not supported the prosecution version which creates doubt on the story of the victim.

He further submitted that the victim was herself a constable and she was aware about the medico-legal examination of a rape victim but deliberately,
the F.I.R. in question was lodged by her after a delay of about five months.

He further submitted that charge sheet was filed by the Investigating Officer in the most mechanical manner for the offences under Sections 506, 354 and 354A I.P.C. as the documents provided by the applicant related to his presence were not considered during the investigation.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant relied on the decision of Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Prashant Bharti Vs. State of N.C.T. of Delhi reported in 2013 (9) SCC 293 and requested for kind indulgence of this Court.

entities.text: Prashant Bharti Vs. State of N.C.T. of Delhi reported in 2013 (9) SCC 293
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the prayer of applicant and submitted that after detailed investigating, charge sheet has been filed and all these facts can be considered by the trial court at the appropriate stage, therefore, application is liable to be dismissed.

7. Considering the submissions of counsel for the parties, going through the contents of application as well as other relevant documents, as in the present case, charge-sheet has already been filed and cognizance has already been taken by the trial court, as it is well settled by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the Case of C.B.I. Vs. Aryan Singh reported in 2023 SCC OnLine SC 379 that in the application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., mini trial at the stage of the quashing of the criminal proceeding is not permissible, therefore, I am of the view that the application is misconceived and liable to be dismissed.

entities.text: C.B.I. Vs. Aryan Singh reported in 2023 SCC OnLine SC 379
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. Accordingly, the Application is hereby dismissed.
